description:
SWBC is seeking a talented individual to develop and maintain our customer interfacing applications and core internal integrations.  This role works within self-organized teams to ensure software is built to customer expectations.
 
 Why you'll love this role: 
 As an application developer for SWBC, you have the ability to work supportive environment that maintains and supports a diverse product portfolio for SWBC partners and employees. The wide range of options available when it comes to products, teams, and technologies provides excellent opportunities for growth and advancement in your career.
 
 Essential duties include the following: 
 Maintains existing systems and fix defects, as necessary.
 Automates processes to improve efficiency.
 Builds tools to eliminate repetitive tasks.
 Participates in self-organizing teams working toward a common goal.
 Responds to issues as they arise and partner with Systems Assurance Group to improve monitoring.
 Performs all other duties as assigned.
 
 Serious candidates will possess the minimum qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four‑year college or university, or equivalent professional experience.
 Minimum three (3) years of professional software development experience.
 Strong working knowledge of object‑oriented programming (OOP) principles and modern development practices. Demonstrated experience applying SOLID principles and common design patterns to build scalable, maintainable systems.
 Proven ability to design, develop, test, and maintain applications using multiple programming languages and frameworks, including:  C#, .NET, JavaScript, jQuery, Angular/React, T‑SQL, HTML, CSS
 Experience designing or integrating agentic AI solutions, including task‑oriented or autonomous agents that leverage foundation models, utilize tool/API invocation, maintain context across multi‑step workflows, and operate within enterprise security and governance standards.
 Familiarity with AI‑assisted development tools and generative AI platforms, such as Anthropic Claude, AWS AI services (including Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and related offerings), GitHub Copilot.
 Experience integrating or consuming AI/ML models and APIs (e.g., recommendation engines, NLP, classification, forecasting).
 Understanding of data pipelines, model inputs/outputs, and AI model lifecycle basics.
 Ability to apply AI techniques to improve developer productivity, automate workflows, enhance user experiences, or improve data insights.
 Experience querying and manipulating data using relational databases; strong SQL skills required.
 Exposure to external data storage systems such as file shares, flat files, databases, and cloud storage.
 Knowledge of current testing frameworks, automation strategies, and quality engineering practices.
 Willingness to continuously learn and adopt emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI capabilities.
 Ability to participate in operational support and on-call rotations as required.Capable of troubleshooting production issues and implementing long-term fixes.
 Able to sit for extended periods performing computer-based, sedentary work.
 
 SWBC offers*:   
 Competitive overall compensation package
 Work/Life balance 
 Employee engagement activities and recognition awards 
 Years of Service awards
 Career enhancement and growth opportunities 
 Leadership Academy and Mentor Program
 Continuing education and career certifications 
 Variety of healthcare coverage options
 Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement plans 
 Lucrative Wellness Program
 
 *Based upon employee eligibility  
      
 Additional Information: 
     
 SWBC is a Substance-Free Workplace and requires pre-employment drug testing.
     
 Please note, SWBC does not hire tobacco users as allowed by law.
     
 To learn more about SWBC, visit our website at www.SWBC.com. If interested, please click the appropriate apply button.
